verdicts.reason: Both break the design the same way. The white cloud graphic is pulled off the photo and floats as a near-invisible white shape on the white banner, so the original photo-plus-cloud composition is gone. 'JOIN OUR CHOIR!' is now tiny and smaller than 'EVERYONE IS WELCOME!', which inverts the hierarchy. The photo is a small thumbnail stranded at the left, and the four elements spread across the width with no grouping. B is only marginally less bad: its photo and cloud are slightly larger, and its headline is a touch bigger.
